Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're doing our procurement checks and need a short interim "bridge" letter to cover the period between the Redwood SOC 2 report end date (2026-04-30) and our contract start (targeting 2026-09-01). Our security team also needs an evidence checklist we can attach to our vendor review packet.

Can you provide a bridge letter (1 paragraph attestation + list of covered controls) and an index of evidence items (stubs are fine) by COB Thursday 2026-08-19 PST? Also, any expected turnaround to provide PDF copies would be helpful.
